explanationZh: 已收件只代表排進清單，不表示已分派人手。

vocabulary.note: 交由某人負責後續工作。

evidence: A request marked “received” is in our queue. It is not necessarily assigned to a technician yet. If you find out that a door which was merely noisy now fails to lock, the new information matters more than a second report. Add the changed symptoms to the original request so staff can see how the problem developed.
